title: Compatible Hom maps for an open stage
statement: With the hypotheses of the parent single-open presentation, set B = t inverse-image W, Z = B.toScheme, s′ = B.ι followed by s, P′ = LP[-n] and Q′ = LQ, where L is schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B. The stage and apex Hom equivalences and both canonical transport equations hold for THESE specified objects. This asserts neither arbitrary perfect endpoints nor perfection or finiteness of the localized objects. [lem-pc-perfect-hom-push-pull-cocone, def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data, lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport].

proof.text: Put B = t inverse-image W and L = schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B. Obtain the open derived pullback adjunction, then obtain hB and its pinned restriction equations from perfect_hom_open_restricted_data. Only this unshifted localization step remains open.

Construct openShiftEquiv explicitly: inverse Hom equivalence for shiftEquiv'(-n,n), inverse Hom equivalence for schemeMVAdjunction, then homFromEquiv of L.commShiftIso(-n) at P. This gives Hom(P,RB* LE[n]) equivalent to Hom(LP[-n],LE). The two Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm equations and associativity prove its postcomposition formula. This step is fully proved in Lean.

Compose openShiftEquiv with hB.stageEquiv j at LP[-n] and with hB.limitEquiv at LP[-n]. Package these equivalences as the witnesses. Rewrite their action on the shifted stage/cocone composites by openShiftEquiv_natural, then apply hB.stageMap and hB.limitMap. The original signature and all its prescribed objects stay identical.

theorem perfect_hom_open_stage_maps
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R)
    (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (ht : W ≤ t.opensRange)
    (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ B : Y.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over B))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q)
    (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F)
    (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d) (n : ℤ)
    :
    let B := t ⁻¹ᵁ W
    let Z := B.toScheme
    let s' := B.ι ≫ s
    let P' := ((schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj P)⟦-n⟧
    let Q' := (schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B).obj Q
    let H := schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage B.ι
    ∃ (e : ∀ j : Set.Ici i, (P ⟶ (H.obj (F.obj j))⟦n⟧) ≃
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s' (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj P' ⟶
         (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s' (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q'))
      (b : (P ⟶ (H.obj d.pt)⟦n⟧) ≃
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s' (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P' ⟶
         (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s' (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q')),
      (∀ (j l : Set.Ici i) (hjl : j ≤ l) (f : P ⟶ (H.obj (F.obj j))⟦n⟧),
        e l (f ≫ (H.map (F.map (homOfLE hjl)))⟦n⟧') =
          perfectStageMap R s' j.property hjl (e j f)) ∧
      (∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (f : P ⟶ (H.obj (F.obj j))⟦n⟧),
        b (f ≫ (H.map (d.ι.app j))⟦n⟧') =
          perfectLimitMap R c s' j.property (e j f))
